role.ja: Sha(E_l/ℚ)の有限性を供給する。Cassels–Tate pairingの交代性とr+dim Sha[2]=1からSha[2]=0とrank=1を得て、γ=(β,1)を有理点で実現する。
role.en: Supplies finiteness of Sha(E_l/ℚ). Alternation of the Cassels–Tate pairing and r+dim Sha[2]=1 give Sha[2]=0 and rank one, so γ=(β,1) comes from a rational point.

hypotheses.ja: E_l:y²=x(x−l)(x+3l)はfull rational two-torsionを持つ。Lemma 3.3のSel₂計算からr+dim Sha[2]=1。full 2∞-Selmer corank=r+t≤r+dim Sha[2]≤1を有限性の使用前に得る。
hypotheses.en: E_l:y²=x(x−l)(x+3l) has full rational two-torsion. Lemma 3.3 gives r+dim Sha[2]=1; the full 2∞-Selmer corank r+t is at most this quantity before invoking finiteness.
